cc:Work.dc:title: Retained MILK10k classification results
cc:Work.dc:description: Each horizontal band identifies one training configuration across all three measures. Circles denote the supervised baseline, squares augmentation with weighted loss, and diamonds contrastive pretraining followed by augmentation and weighted loss. All values are preserved in assets/results.csv. Each metric uses a shared scale across the two tasks.
